$comment: Mirrors the Walk schema in src/walk-data.ts; change both together.
title: Tandem walk
description: A walk through the code, shown in the Walk view: explaining it, proposing changes to it, or both.

title.description: Names the walk. A new title starts the reader at step 1 with an empty review.

check.description: Label of the optional checkbox on every step.

base.description: Locally available ref used to find the merge-base.

head.description: Locally available head ref; omit to compare the working tree.

filePath.description: Path from the workspace root. Not absolute, and without "..".

id.description: Unique within the walk. The reader's progress and note follow this id.

details.description: The longer explanation, shown on "Show more".

places.description: Ordered code locations. Focus opens the first; an empty list is valid.

quote.description: Literal code to highlight. With compare, may occur in either version; must not be ambiguous in either.
